$comment: The criteria an internal audit checks the Frames' clauses: frontmatter against: clause numbers and short titles only, never the standards' text (it is copyrighted; an audit is judged against this organization's own SOPs and the clauses they cite). A Frame cites a clause of the default standard by its number ("9.2") and any other as "<standard>:<number>" ("iso13485:8.2.4", "21cfr820:820.35", "21cfr11:11.10"). A clause counts as covered when a Frame cites it, a clause above it or one below it.
